mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a built-in outdoor grill project with your firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Following this, we conduct an on-site visit to assess the space and gather necessary details. We then develop a detailed design proposal, including layouts and material selections. Once approved, we handle all aspects from permitting to construction and final installation, ensuring a smooth and transparent project experience.
